page_title: MNU 1-2 FUL | Manchester Utd v Fulham 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+10' This is a yellow card! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+10' The referee is firm and issues Tom Cairney (Fulham) a deserved yellow card.
90+9' It's time for a substitution. Antony (Manchester United) comes on in place of Victor Lindelof.

90+7' 1 - 2 GOAL! Adama Traore finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Alex Iwobi (Fulham), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 1:2.
90+5' Manchester Utd work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+5' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.
90+5' The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester Utd can continue in their attacking effort.

90+5' A sweet pass finds Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Bernd Leno is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Manchester Utd have a corner.
90+3' Bernd Leno makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) after a cross from the side.
90' Bernd Leno (Fulham) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90' Michael Oliver sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Manchester Utd players aren’t happy.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 1 Goal! Harry Maguire (Manchester United) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:1.

89' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the right side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Bernd Leno.
86' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
85' The Manchester Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
82' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
81' Here is a change. Harry Wilson is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Issa Diop (Fulham).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is coming onto the pitch as Kobbie Mainoo cannot continue after picking up an injury.

80' Christian Eriksen whips in the corner and finds Harry Maguire (Manchester United) in space with just the keeper to beat, but somehow he plants his header just over the bar from close in. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
80' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
80' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.

79' Harry Wilson (Fulham) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Adama Traore (Fulham) is replacing Harrison Reed.

76' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
75' Harrison Reed (Fulham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
74' A player from Manchester Utd commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

73' The opposition back off Marcus Rashford (Manchester United), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the roof of the net, but Bernd Leno denies him with the save.
73' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

72' A lofted cross from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.

72' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Bernd Leno was alert and the score remains the same.

71' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
70' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will deliver the corner kick.

70' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Manchester Utd win a corner.
70' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

70' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester Utd.
69' Harrison Reed (Fulham) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Cairney (Fulham) comes onto the pitch so that Andreas Pereira can be given a rest.
65' 0 - 1 Goal! Calvin Bassey (Fulham) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
65' Corner kick. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is ready to send the ball into the box.

65' Harrison Reed (Fulham) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the top of the net. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Andre Onana does well to punch it away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

62' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a throw-in.
60' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fulham. Ball possession – 52:48.
58' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will take the corner.
58' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.
57' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to find Andreas Pereira, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
56' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
55' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call.
53' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Omari Forson is replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
53' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) takes to the field as the replacement for Casemiro, who couldn’t continue due to his head injury.
52' Harrison Reed (Fulham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
49' Harrison Reed (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Casemiro (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
48' Dangerous play by Harrison Reed (Fulham). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.

48' Andreas Pereira swings in the free kick towards Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham), who powers a header well wide of the left post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
47' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
47' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Harry Wilson (Fulham) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
43' Omari Forson (Manchester United) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
42' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
42' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

41' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

39' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Andre Onana, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
39' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
37' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Harry Maguire (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.

33' OFF THE POST! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

33' Alejandro Garnacho releases Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.

32' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the left post. Aim better, sir. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
29' Fulham take a short corner kick.

29' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the right side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort. Fulham earn a corner.
28' Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
28' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.

27' What a great touch by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
25' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Oliver had an easy-decision to make.
24' Manchester Utd control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
21' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
21' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
21' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
21' Manchester Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

20' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but the defence gets it clear. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

18' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
17' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Fulham.
16' A cross from a corner kick by Manchester Utd is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

14' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
13' Harrison Reed (Fulham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
8' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) jumps into a tackle and Michael Oliver signals a foul.

4' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Andre Onana was alert and the score remains the same.
3' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The match has just started.
Fulham will kick-off.
Michael Oliver will supervise the game today.
